name: 000-lupios-system
description: LupiOS: its own system services may connect without asking: DNS (systemd-resolved), network setup (NetworkManager), time (chronyd), and system and firmware updates (rpm-ostree, bootc, uupd, fwupd). Programs that can download or upload anything you tell them to (skopeo, podman, flatpak) are only pre-approved for root: see 001-lupios-root-tools. A deny rule of your own still wins, and you can edit or delete this rule like any other.
